name: Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Fields
aliases: Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Fields (Bernardon et al.)
definition: A technique extending vector quantization to encode scalar fields based on temporal coherence in a hierarchical data structure for time-varying unstructured grids.
summary: Vector Quantization for Time-Varying Fields is a compression technique for scalar fields on unstructured grids that exploits temporal coherence to enable efficient, low-overhead rendering.
